title: Baseline and contracts
source_revision_note: Committed P00 baseline test source, not P00 exit closure. CT12 and CT14 controller decisions and hosted CI evidence remain open. The earlier e2112c4 baseline anchor is historical context.

packages.name: @blindpass/sps-server
packages.responsibility: Fastify API, authentication, exchange policy, Redis request state and PostgreSQL management data

packages.name: @blindpass/gateway
packages.responsibility: Interception, secure-link routing and agent identity helpers

packages.name: @blindpass/agent-skill
packages.responsibility: HPKE, SPS clients, runtime memory and exchange helpers

packages.name: @blindpass/openclaw-plugin
packages.responsibility: OpenClaw integration, encrypted store, resolver and MCP entry point

packages.name: @blindpass/browser-ui
packages.responsibility: Vite secret-input page and client-side encryption

packages.name: @blindpass/dashboard
packages.p00_disposition: preserve current implementation; future rebuild remains gated

packages.name: @blindpass/contract-tests
packages.responsibility: Black-box CT01–CT18, CV01–CV06 and CC01 baseline harness

database.plaintext_secret_inventory: No source secret values are intended to persist in PostgreSQL; management records, policy, session metadata and audit metadata do.

redis.plaintext_secret_inventory: Submitted encrypted payloads are temporary request/exchange state; plaintext is consumed by the browser or trusted client, not the relay audit path.

deployment.rust_controller: scaffold present; HTTP/database parity not implemented
deployment.host_broker: P01 local broker ran live ephemeral HPKE provisioning and dedicated non-root consumers on committed SHA a45c3d027f27fcaf5a870c6f2ca3b334c2d16a57; review found P01-I01 and P01-I06 unestablished, so W0 acceptance remains open
deployment.linux_vm_fleet: Original harness on committed SHA a45c3d027f27fcaf5a870c6f2ca3b334c2d16a57 exited successfully on disposable Ubuntu 24.04/systemd 255 KVM; revised committed-SHA run, alternate guest matrix and stock-client evidence remain open

dependencies.socket_review: Pre-upgrade full scan of 16 JS/Cargo manifests and lockfiles (0d2bc0fb-57d3-41ce-bea7-ed4ac29703ee) failed on Vitest 3.2.4 criticalCVE. Exact four-package candidate lockfile scan (32dd9991-31a0-4f0a-b381-4658299ea009) passed organization policy but triggered dependency-guard human review for medium capability alerts and a 64/100 score. The user approved that slice; Vitest, Vite, Fastify and react-router-dom manifests and lockfile are updated. Final repository Socket scan (2f43843e-a3d2-4aee-90bd-0eac5eb0e731) passed organization policy over 20 manifests/lockfiles. Post-upgrade npm audit reports 10 advisories, none critical.

evidence_gaps: No production database, backup, installation or live-link inventory was accessed.
The Linux Fleet Pilot still requires real systemd VM and stock-client evidence.
Rust controller parity and native/container fleet parity remain unimplemented.

P01 original selected-profile VM harness passed on committed SHA a45c3d027f27fcaf5a870c6f2ca3b334c2d16a57, but P01-I01 and P01-I06 acceptance are not established; revised VM and broader matrices remain open.

P00 CT12 issuer-admin and CT14 auth-shape decisions and hosted PR-CI execution remain open. The two Redis-gated cases skipped in the PostgreSQL run are executed separately by the Redis integration gate. Local P00-I06 snapshot-mismatch and skipped-suite gate fault injections passed on 2026-09-23.
